name: Dream Date
source:
Dream Date is a dating sim where you do not have to win anyone's heart, but you experience a date in an already established relationship.

Listen to your partner's thoughts, choose from two responses, and learn more about your partner's story. 

[from [url=https://grassu.itch.io/dream-date]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Dream Date》是一款恋爱模拟游戏。你无需赢得谁的芳心，而是与已经交往的恋人共度一场约会。

倾听恋人的心声，从两个回答中作出选择，进一步了解对方的故事。

[摘自[url=https://grassu.itch.io/dream-date]itch.io[/url]]
